channel.title: Epic Fury Live — US-Iran War Tracker
channel.description: Live tracking of the US-Israel-Iran conflict. Real-time updates, verified casualties, evidence, and analysis.

item.title: Iranian president says time to end war with US from ‘position of strength’
item.description: Omani and Iranian foreign ministers hold a call as Washington prepares economic sanctions.

item.title: Several killed in Russia’s ‘double-tap’ drone strike on Ukraine mall
item.description: Ukraine’s president accuses Russia of a ‘cowardly and deliberate’ attack on a mall in his hometown of Kryvyi Rih.

item.title: Iran war live: Trump says he views Strait of Hormuz as ‘American territory’
item.description: US president says Iran 'would love to make a deal, but they’re not ready to make the right deal in my opinion'.

item.title: Trump: ‘We’re seeing what happens’ on sanctions for Iran
item.description: Donald Trump repeated claims that Iran is weakened economically and militarily and ‘would love’ to make a deal.

item.title: One killed, three wounded in sword attack at Swedish high school
item.description: One person has been killed and three others wounded in an attack by a sword-wielding man at a Swedish high school.

item.title: Western allies slam Israel for ending World Central Kitchen strike probe
item.description: UK, Australia and Canada call Israel’s decision not to investigate deadly 2024 strike on a Gaza aid convoy 'shameful'.

item.title: Israel re-establishes closed West Bank settlement, defying growing international protests
item.description: Thirty "pioneer families" have arrived on a wave of nationalism driven by Israel's government, but the rapid change has left nearby Palestinian residents fearful.

item.title: One killed in sword attack at Swedish school
item.description: Officials say another three people were injured, and an 18-year-old male suspect shot and arrested.

item.title: UK, Canada and Australia condemn Israel for refusing criminal probe into aid worker killings in Gaza
item.description: Seven World Central Kitchen workers were killed in the Israeli strike on their convoy in 2024.

item.title: Ebola vaccine trial to start in DR Congo as warning issued over speed of infections
item.description: About half of the 2,500 recorded deaths from Ebola happened in the last 20 days, the WHO says.
